content: इव {%ind.%} .²1 Like, as (showing उपमा or comparison); वागर्थाविव संपृक्तौ <ls>R. 1. 1</ls>; वैनतेय इव विनतानन्दनः <ls>K. 5</ls>. .²2 As if, as it were (denoting उत्प्रेक्षा); पश्यामीव पिनाकिनम् <ls>Ś. 1. 6</ls>. लिम्पतीव तमोङ्गानि वर्षतीवाञ्जनं नभः <ls>Mk. 1. 34</ls>. .²3 Little, somewhat, perhaps; कडार इवायम् <ls>G. M.</ls> .²4 (Added to interrogative words), ‘Possibly’, ‘I should like to know’, ‘indeed’; विना सीतादेव्या किमिव हि न दुःखं रघुपतेः <ls>U. 6. 30</ls>; {@क इव@} of what sort, what-like; क इव कालः <ls>Māl. 2</ls>; what a long time has elapsed. .²5 इव is frequently used with adverbs, especially with such as involve restriction, by way of emphasis in the sense of even or just so, just, exactly, quite, indeed, very; मुहूर्तमिव but for a moment; किंचिदिव just a little bit; so ईषदिव, नाचिरादिव, <ab>&c.</ab>; (इव is considered by grammarians as forming compounds with the word after which it stands; इवेन समासो विभक्त्यलोपश्च <ls>Vārt.</ls> on <ls>P. II. 4. 71. Sk.</ls>).
